info.title: CryptoDataDownload — API
info.description:
Programmatic access to the CryptoDataDownload historical-data and computed-feature catalog — Deribit options analytics, Binance OHLCV with multi-year depth, cross-venue funding rates, on-chain signals, and a deep set of pre-computed ML features and risk metrics.

Authentication — token via the Authorize button (Token <your_token_id>) or the ?auth_token=<your_token_id> query parameter. Get a token at cryptodatadownload.com/api/.

get.description:
### Returns
Wide-row composite of all 22 Phase-2 ML features joined on the (symbol, date) key. ~70 columns covering return / vol / momentum / microstructure / options-implied / positioning / macro / regime dimensions in one row.

### Interpretation
The ready-to-model feature vector for crypto cross-sectional and time-series strategies. One API call replaces 22 round-trips during model input prep. Pass `fields=` to return only a subset of columns (saves bandwidth on large training pulls).

### Response Schema
| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `symbol` | `string` | Binance spot symbol |
| `date` | `string` | Snapshot date |
| `return_rank_z_{1d,5d,20d,60d}` | `float` | Cross-sectional return z-scores |
| `vol_rank_z` | `float` | Cross-sectional vol z-score |
| `momentum_{12_1,6_1,3_1}` | `float` | Academic momentum factors (skip-last) |
| `reversal_signal` | `float` | 5d mean-reversion signal |
| `hurst_60d` | `float` | Hurst exponent (60d window) |
| `beta_btc_{30d,60d,180d}` | `float` | Rolling beta vs BTC |
| `order_flow_imbalance_z` | `float` | OFI z-score (60d window) |
| `large_trade_share` | `float` | Daily large-print volume fraction |
| `volume_profile_{poc,vah,val}` | `float` | Auction-theory volume profile |
| `xexchange_spread_pct` | `float` | Cross-exchange basis (BTC vs USD venues) |
| `atm_iv_30d / implied_move_30d` | `float` | Options-implied move (BTC/ETH) |
| `skew_25d_30d / smile_width_30d` | `float` | Skew + smile geometry (BTC/ETH) |
| `oi_concentration_hhi` | `float` | Options OI Herfindahl (BTC/ETH) |
| `funding_regime_label` | `string` | extreme_negative … extreme_positive |
| `oi_change_pct_{1d,5d,20d}` | `float` | Perp OI changes |
| `perp_basis_ann_pct` | `float` | Annualized perp basis (BTC/ETH/SOL/BNB) |
| `yield_curve_pc{1,2,3}` | `float` | Treasury curve PCA factors |
| `real_rate_regime` | `string` | very_low … very_high |
| `cot_positioning_z` | `float` | CFTC COT z (BTC/ETH only) |
| `anomaly_score` | `float` | Mahalanobis distance from 90d distribution |
| `regime_state` | `string` | trending_up / trending_down / mean_reverting |
| `regime_prob_*` | `float` | Posterior probabilities of each regime state |
| `cluster_id / cluster_size` | `int` | K=6 hierarchical clustering on 60d corr |

### Source
- **Update cadence** · daily 17:30 UTC (~5 min after the last upstream feat_* completes), plus 00:30 UTC next-day safety-net gapfill

### Notes
**Materialized** — single S3 GET, no on-demand joins. Use `fields=` to project just the columns you need.

get.description:
### Returns
Daily count of symbols making new 52-week highs vs new 52-week lows across the supported Binance universe.

### Interpretation
The classic breadth indicator. Persistent high count of new highs = broad-based bull regime; high count of new lows = broad weakness. Composite (highs − lows) often leads index price.

### Response Schema

| `date` | `string` | Snapshot date |

| `new_52week_lows` | `integer` | Symbols printing new 52w lows |

### Returns
JSON array of CFTC Commitments-of-Traders contract names / asset groups exposed by the COT timeseries endpoint.

### Interpretation
The COT report covers ~120 contracts across crypto, equities, FX, commodities. This catalog returns the exact `name` strings the timeseries endpoint accepts.

### Coverage
- **Element type** · `string`
- **Universe size** · ~120 contracts (crypto + equity + FX + commodity + rates)
- **Refresh** · weekly — refreshed each Friday after CFTC publishes the COT report (for prior Tuesday's position-as-of)
- **Scope** · Includes CME crypto contracts (BITCOIN, MICRO BITCOIN, ETHER, MICRO ETHER) plus the major equity indices, FX, gold, oil, treasuries. Names follow CFTC's official contract designation (case-sensitive).

### Paired Data Endpoint
- [`/v1/data/cftc/cot/`](#operations-tag-) — COT timeseries
- [`/v1/data/features/macro/cot-positioning/`](#operations-tag-) — Phase-2 COT positioning z-score feature

### Returns
Daily basis (futures vs spot) for the requested base currency across the perp and quarterly contracts on Binance. Includes annualized carry % and days-to-expiry for each contract.

### Interpretation
The cost/yield of being long/short futures vs spot at each maturity. Positive basis = contango (futures > spot); negative = backwardation. The annualized carry is the basis-trade APY before funding/borrow.

| `basis_pct` | `float` | (futures - spot) / spot · 100 |
| `annualized_carry_pct` | `float` | Annualized basis-trade APY |

### Returns
Classic 3-factor decomposition of the US Treasury yield curve. PC1 explains parallel level shifts, PC2 captures slope (steepening/flattening), and PC3 captures curvature (humps/inversions).

### Interpretation
Distills the full yield curve into 3 numbers. PC1 = rates regime; PC2 = recession signal (PC2 falling = curve flattening); PC3 = monetary-policy distortions. Var explained columns show how much each factor matters today.

### Response Schema

|---|---|---|
| `date` | `string` | Snapshot date |

| `pc3_curvature` | `float` | Loading on the curvature factor |
| `pc1_var_pct` | `float` | % variance explained by PC1 |
| `pc2_var_pct` | `float` | % variance explained by PC2 |

### Returns
Daily IV surface grid — 9 moneyness × ~13 maturities — smoothed via Nadaraya-Watson kernel regression. Each row is one (strike, DTE, moneyness) cell with both the raw IV and the kernel-smoothed value.

### Interpretation
The full implied vol topology — readable as a 2D heatmap by strike × maturity. Useful for spotting term-structure waves, skew steepening at specific DTEs, and discrete listings (single-event days). `n_observations` indicates how many quotes contributed to each cell — sparse cells have higher smoothing weight.
